sloka: एतत् श्रुत्वा प्रियम् वाक्यम् ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम् ।देवा महर्षयः सर्वे प्रहृष्टाः ते अभवन् तदा ॥१-१५-१५॥
transliteration: etat śrutvā priyam vākyam brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam ।devā maharṣayaḥ sarve prahṛṣṭāḥ te abhavan tadā ॥1-15-15॥

translations.english: Having heard these pleasing words uttered by Brahma, all the devatas and maharshis were overwhelmed with joy.
